title: Replace Internet Identity with native username/password sign-in and ensure admin login works

requirements.text: Implement a native authentication system (no Google / no Internet Identity) that lets users create an account with a username and password, then sign in using those credentials, with no email verification step.

quotes: OK, so instead of when you sign in it redirects you you sign in with Google I want it to have its own sign in page. You don’t have to confirm with your email where you can either create a username and a password and it will save in the system

acceptanceCriteria: The app provides a dedicated Sign In page and a Create Account (Sign Up) flow.
Sign Up requires at minimum: username + password (and password confirmation).
No email collection or email verification is required anywhere in the UI or backend.
After successful Sign Up, the user can Sign In with the created username/password and is treated as authenticated across the app until they sign out.
Passwords are never stored or returned in plaintext by the backend (store only a salted/hashed representation).

requirements.text: Add backend session support for username/password authentication and use it to authorize all user-protected and admin-protected backend operations (replacing principal-based authorization checks).

quotes: create a username and a password and it will save in the system
then as well as the admin login I want that to work

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes auth methods for: signUp, signIn, signOut (optional), getSession (or equivalent), returning a session token on successful sign-in.
Backend stores session state so that subsequent calls using a valid session token are treated as authenticated as the associated user.

All existing protected operations (create order, view user orders, view order detail, update order status, list all orders, profile access) enforce authorization using the session token rather than the caller Principal permissions.
Invalid/expired session tokens are rejected with clear errors (e.g., "Unauthorized").

requirements.text: Update the order ownership model and queries so user dashboards show only the signed-in user’s orders under the new username/password identity system, and admins can still view/update all orders.

quotes: then as well as the admin login I want that to work

acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in user creates an order, the order is associated with that authenticated user identity (not the Internet Identity principal).
Dashboard order list shows only orders for the currently signed-in user session.
Order detail page blocks access if the order is not owned by the current signed-in user session (unless the session is an admin session).
Admin panel can list all orders and update any order’s status using an admin session.

requirements.text: Create a dedicated Sign In page and integrate it into routing and UI navigation so the app does not prompt for Internet Identity anywhere (including AuthGate copy and landing page messaging).

quotes: I want it to have its own sign in page.

acceptanceCriteria: A new route exists for Sign In (and Sign Up if separate), and it is reachable from signed-out states.
Any UI that previously instructed users to use “Internet Identity” is updated to refer to signing in with username/password (English copy).
AuthGate no longer renders a button that triggers Internet Identity login; instead it directs the user to the Sign In page.
Brand header authentication controls support: Sign In (when signed out) and Sign Out (when signed in), based on the new auth state.
Landing page “How It Works” step text is updated to match the new sign-in method (username/password).

requirements.text: Ensure admin login works under the same username/password system by adding an admin role concept to the new user account model and updating the admin gating logic accordingly.

quotes: then as well as the admin login I want that to work

acceptanceCriteria: Backend supports determining whether the current session token corresponds to an admin user (e.g., an isAdmin flag or role).
Frontend AdminGate uses the new backend admin check (based on the session token) to allow/deny access to /admin.
A signed-in admin user sees the Admin navigation entry and can access the Admin Panel successfully.
A signed-in non-admin user receives an “Access Denied” state on /admin.

requirements.text: Add a conditional state migration so that upgrading from the existing Internet Identity/principal-owned data does not break the canister at upgrade time, and existing stored orders remain readable after upgrade.

quotes: it will save in the system

acceptanceCriteria: If existing stable state is present, the canister upgrades successfully without trapping.
Existing orders can still be returned by admin listing after upgrade (even if they become “legacy-owned”).
Migration is only added/used if required by the current stored data layout (respect the project’s conditional migration policy).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend immutablePaths (including frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, and frontend/src/main.tsx); implement the new username/password auth flow without modifying those files.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if a state upgrade requires it.
Use English for all user-facing UI text.
Maintain existing ROLEPLAY-ONLY / NOT VALID ID disclaimers and watermark behavior; do not weaken or remove safety/clarity messaging.
nonGoals: Do not implement third-party authentication providers (Google, Facebook, GitHub, Auth0).
Do not add email collection, email verification, password reset emails, or SMS verification.
Do not add payment/Venmo instruction screens in this change (not requested in the latest message).
Do not introduce external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
